heading: Reports concerning pen registers and trap and trace devices
lead: The Attorney General shall annually report to Congress on the number of pen register orders and orders for trap and trace devices applied for by law enforcement agencies of the Department of Justice, which report shall include information concerning—

tree.text: the period of interceptions authorized by the order, and the number and duration of any extensions of the order;
the offense specified in the order or application, or extension of an order;
the number and nature of the facilities affected; and
the identity, including district, of the applying investigative or law enforcement agency making the application and the person authorizing the order.

notes.text: Prior ProvisionsA prior section 3126 was renumbered section 3127 of this title.

Amendments2000—Pub. L. 106–197 substituted “, which report shall include information concerning—” and pars. (1) to (5) for period at end. 1988—Pub. L. 100–690 renumbered section 3125 of this title as this section.
